name: LELB Simple Floating Contact
author: LELB Society

sections.description:
LELB Simple Floating Contact adds a compact floating button to your website. Visitors can open it to access the contact methods you configure.

Features:
* WhatsApp, Telegram, and telephone contact links.
* Enable or disable the widget.
* Configure the button background color.
* Choose bottom-right or bottom-left positioning.
* Show or hide contact labels.
* Option to open external contact links in a new tab.
* Option to add the nofollow relationship attribute.
* Keyboard support, including Escape to close.
* Customizable accessible labels for the open and close controls.
* Screen-reader labels, keyboard support, and visible keyboard focus.
* No external scripts, tracking, accounts, or API connections.
* Frontend assets are loaded only when the widget is enabled and at least one contact method is configured.

Privacy

The plugin itself does not collect, store, or transmit visitor personal data, and it does not load third-party scripts or connect to external APIs. When a visitor follows a contact link, the destination service’s own privacy policy and practices apply.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or extract the plugin directory into /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Floating Contact.
  4. Add one or more contact methods and adjust the appearance settings.
  5. Save your changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin provide live chat?

No. It displays links to contact services configured by the site administrator. Conversations take place in the selected external service or telephone application.

Does the plugin connect to WhatsApp or Telegram APIs?

No. It simply links visitors to the contact URLs you provide.

Why is the button not visible after activation?

The widget is displayed only when it is enabled and at least one contact method has been configured.

Can I display the button on the left side?

Yes. Choose Bottom left under Settings > Floating Contact.
